events.name: GXY STRATOSPHERE
events.summary: Part of the STRATOSPHERE / HIGH STRATOSPHERE group of events Tuesday & Thursday at the same time.
events.description:
Part of the STRATOSPHERE / HIGH STRATOSPHERE group of events Tuesday & Thursday at the same time.

An event that starts as a steady state ride but builds towards the end with an optional power pyramid or intervals.

EVENT DYNAMICS

Category	- C
Power - 1.9 > 2.3 wkg . But expect the event to finish with an average power around 2.1wkg based on a 75kgs rider.
Fence	- Enabled to KICK when in use, used at the leader's discretion	
Draft	- Enabled – focus required to stay within the group
Sweeper	- No

ETHOS 

We at GXY are committed to creating a culture of belonging, inclusivity and compassion empowering people to grow stronger, work together and support one another to achieve shared success on Zwift

GXY – Here together, for you 💜

If you want to become a member and join our community to race, ride socially, or both, please come and join ideally via our Facebook link:

events.name: GXY RIDE THE RAINBOW
events.summary: Part of the RIDE THE RAINBOW group of workout events Tuesday and Thursday at the same time
events.description:
Part of the RIDE THE RAINBOW group of workout events Tuesday and Thursday at the same time

This event is a workout ride based on your individual Functional Threshold Power (FTP).  This is not a group ride and has no draft effect.  The coloured power zones will be called out by the ride leader during the event.  Expect them to fluctuate throughout the rainbow colours.

Once you understand the concept of how this event works, you will find that it is fun, engaging and a tough workout all-in-one

EVENT DYNAMICS

Category	- E
Power 	- 1.0 > 5.0wkg wholly dependent on your own FTP rating
Draft	- No
Sweeper 	- No
